author: reek
body: The first cut of the Ability IR: compile a card's Oracle text into the engine's existing Effect / Ability AST so spells actually resolve. Old School spells are mostly single-effect, so we detect one primary effect per card by matching templated clauses and extracting its number. This is deliberately approximate (no targeting restrictions, one effect per card); the full dated Ability IR is the larger phase. The engine already applies these Effects, so parsing them makes real burn, removal, card draw, and life gain fire.
